method: Conservative textual reuse: AST-unparse selected predecessor bodies and new production modules, remove comments/docstrings/imports, trim line indentation; count SequenceMatcher contiguous equal blocks of at least three lines once per mapped new module. Matching concepts or rewritten logic receive no reuse credit.

source_readonly_check.scope: Predecessor source, tests, configuration, documentation, scripts and private environment-file hashes captured at extraction start; operational datasets were not copied.
